skill.name: reasoningbank-intelligence
skill.description: Guides implementation of ReasoningBank adaptive learning for pattern recognition, strategy optimization, persistent experience tracking, and meta-learning in AI agents.
skill.summary: Build adaptive AI agents that learn from experience and improve strategy choices over time.
skill.author: DNYoussef

content.value_statement: Agents often repeat weak strategies because outcomes are not captured for later use. This skill shows how to record experiences, learn patterns, and recommend better strategies with ReasoningBank.
actual_capabilities: Initialize ReasoningBank with persistent AgentDB storage.
Record task outcomes with metrics and contextual labels.
Teach agents to learn and match reusable patterns.
Compare strategies and select the strongest option for a task type.
Apply meta-learning and transfer learning between related domains.
Track learning effectiveness through ReasoningBank metrics.
limitations: Requires agentic-flow and AgentDB packages in the host project.
Provides implementation guidance, not a standalone service.
Needs enough recorded experiences before recommendations are reliable.
Does not define privacy controls for stored task context.

use_cases.title: Improve Code Review Agents
use_cases.description: Record review outcomes and recommend strategies based on language, complexity, and prior success metrics.

use_cases.title: Optimize Workflow Automation
use_cases.description: Compare task strategies and reuse learned patterns when workflows repeat across projects.

use_cases.title: Prototype Self-Learning Assistants
use_cases.description: Build agents that store experiences, learn transfer rules, and measure improvement over time.

prompt_templates.title: Start ReasoningBank
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to initialize ReasoningBank with AgentDB persistence for my Node.js agent project.

prompt_templates.title: Record Experiences
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to record task outcomes, metrics, and context in ReasoningBank for code review tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Strategies
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose better approaches using prior results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ReasoningBank to compare three debugging strategies and recommend one for a high-complexity TypeScript issue.

prompt_templates.title: Design Adaptive Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an adaptive agent loop that recommends a strategy, executes it, records the result, and updates learned patterns.

output_examples.input: Initialize adaptive learning for an agent that handles code review tasks.
output_examples.output: A ReasoningBank setup plan with persistence, learning rate settings, and experience fields for task, approach, metrics, and context.

output_examples.input: Find the best strategy for fixing a recurring API deployment issue.
output_examples.output: A strategy comparison workflow that checks learned patterns, ranks options, and records the selected outcome for future recommendations.

output_examples.input: Measure whether the agent is improving over time.
output_examples.output: A metrics review approach covering total experiences, learned patterns, strategy success rate, and observed improvement.

best_practices: Record both successful and failed outcomes so recommendations are balanced.
Attach clear context labels such as task type, language, complexity, and constraints.
Review learned patterns regularly and remove stale or low-confidence entries.
anti_patterns: Do not store secrets, tokens, or personal data in experience context.
Do not trust recommendations before enough relevant experiences exist.
Do not let auto-learning update models without confidence thresholds.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build agents that learn from past outcomes and improve strategy selection over time.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: It is a Markdown skill with TypeScript examples. It does not include scripts or runnable package files.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What dependencies are expected?
faq.answer: The skill references agentic-flow, AgentDB, and Node.js 18 or newer.

faq.question: How much data is needed?
faq.answer: The troubleshooting guidance recommends at least 100 experiences per task type for better recommendations.

faq.question: What should users avoid storing?
faq.answer: Users should avoid storing secrets, credentials, private customer data, or unnecessary personal data in learned experiences.
